description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Stonecloaker. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Stonecloaker trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat
